names: Kaiser Permanente San Francisco Mission Bay Medical Offices
summary: A nine-story outpatient medical office building at 1600 Owens Street (about 200,000 sq ft per Potrero View, 500 physicians and support staff, no emergency services) that Potrero View reported in February 2016 would open the next month; the Assessor roll gives 2016 as year built and the Department of Building Inspection records the building's interior fit-out permit completed on 2016-02-04.

milestones.text: Altered site permit application 201308083838 filed to change occupancy to business (office) and reduce the building from 10 stories to 9 stories (original site permit 2007/11/09/7802)
SocketSite reports the nine-story Mission Bay Medical Office Building at 1600 Owens Street is scheduled to finish in late 2015, with Kaiser operating from it starting in early 2016
Permit application 201312194614 filed for 182,000 gross interior sq ft of medical office (outpatient) fit-out in a 9-story shell (estimated cost $50,000,000); issued 2014-07-28

Interior fit-out permit 201312194614 recorded as complete on 2016-02-04; Potrero View reports (February 2016) that the offices open the next month, March 2016 (pre-opening announcement); the Assessor roll lists 2016 as year built

costs.what: Estimated cost stated on interior fit-out permit 201312194614 (self-reported for the permit fee)

facts.value: Nine (Potrero View; SocketSite; the 2013 altered site permit reduced it from 10); the Assessor roll gives 10
About 200,000 sq ft (Potrero View); 182,000 gross interior sq ft of fit-out on the permit; 250,884 sq ft Assessor property_area
Outpatient medical offices: primary care, specialty care and support services; not a hospital and no emergency services
No parking in the building; patients expected to use the existing 820-space garage at 1670 Owens Street (SocketSite, 2013)

open_questions: No post-opening source was read: the March 2016 opening rests on Potrero View's February 2016 announcement ('opens next month'), the permit closeout and the Assessor year built. Kaiser's own facility page redirected in a loop and could not be read.

The STUDIOS Architecture project page (cited in the map note for architect, 220,000 sq ft, Whiting-Turner, LEED Platinum and the purchase by Kaiser) returned HTTP 404 to the fetch, so architect, contractor, LEED rating and the sale are not recorded here.

The developer (map note says Alexandria Real Estate Equities, citing its 3Q14 supplemental) is not named in the pages read: that supplemental lists other Owens Street addresses but not 1600 Owens. SocketSite (2013) reader comments say it was a developer-built building bought by Kaiser; comments are not a source.
Kaiser's sale price and date, and the construction start date, are not stated in any source read.
